measurement.invocation_definition: Each grouped functions.exec call with one nested exec_command and one Python script counts as one invocation. Three official CLI administrative calls are excluded.

command_read_event_ledger.command: Python: first UTC clock read; read and print assigned PROMPT.txt
Python: list assigned participant files and stat sizes; read and print questions.json; check UTC elapsed
Python: read manifest.json, community.md, agent-value.md once each; print numbered lines; check UTC elapsed
Python: create assigned output directory; construct and write final.json and account.md; reread and validate outputs; record final UTC and rewrite final.json; print final clock

measurement.prior_knowledge_exposure: Only parent assignment, official task #97 metadata, general workspace instructions and supplied redo prompt/questions/corpus were available for this work. No candidate report, reference labels, other arms, discussion or other study directories were inspected.

limitations: This is one full independent-redo baseline by a fresh same-operator session, not independent external participation or a verification arm. No general cost advantage can be established.
Only supplied pinned documents were used; their assertions were not verified against live deployment, code or GitHub.
No exact model identifier, reasoning setting, token counts, billed cost or preparation telemetry was exposed; those fields are null.
Raw file-byte counts are measured; they are not tokens. Script stdout was model-visible output and is not added to raw source-byte totals; stdout byte counts are unavailable.

Clock checks were printed in invocations 2 and 3. Invocation 1 read the start clock before the prompt but did not read a second end clock; its elapsed check was delayed until invocation 2. Final timestamp is captured immediately before final measurement persistence, with a post-write clock in terminal stdout.
Official task administration (show, failed network show, escalated show and start) preceded measurement and is excluded as instructed. Isolation was procedural.
